opening.argument: The speaker personally recommends buying Serum at a supposed discount, tells holders not to sell, and predicts that it will eventually recover: "serum is on the big discount, so its good if you buy now i think that serum is on the bottom" and "eventually serum will go back up." This is direct investment encouragement, not a reported third-party offer. The categorical statement that "D.C.A is never a losing strategy, right?" materially overstates the certainty of dollar-cost averaging, even though the speaker qualifies some investment commentary with "I think." Separately, the appeal to DeFi Land's developers for future token access and early-adopter rewards is a request to developers, not evidence that they offered access or required viewers to pay or provide data.
